mapper.select: select * from `Auct_FileUpload` where anum = #{anum} order by sort_no, fnum
select * from `Auct_FileUpload` where anum in #{anum} order by anum, sort_no, fnum
mapper.insert: insert into Auct_FileUpload (anum, upload_path, file_name, file_dname, file_ext, sort_no) values (#{anum}, #{upload_path}, #{file_name}, #{file_dname}, #{file_ext}, #{sort_no})
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(sort_no), -1) from Auct_FileUpload where anum = #{anum}
select coalesce(min(sort_no), 0) from Auct_FileUpload where anum = #{anum}
mapper.update: update Auct_FileUpload set sort_no = #{sortNo} where fnum = #{fnum} and anum = #{anum}
